fusions.name: Shaken Skep
fusions.desc: Shakes the hive hung from the staff and looses 3 bees in a spread out to 5 tiles. Each deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Alarm Scent
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that smears the hive's alarm scent on the target. It deals 11 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Dripping Comb
fusions.desc: Plants the staff with its comb dripping honey. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Forager's Miles
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover on foot restores 5 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
